title: Harden updatedb configuration migration

checks.what: locate.sh hardens PRUNEPATHS rewriting through the fixed awk program (data-as-data, no sed interpolation)
the migration pins UPDATEDB_CONF_PATH to /etc/updatedb.conf (env override removed)
